earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Total revenue of $1.56 billion and total net sales of $1.32 billion in the third quarter of 2026, each an increase of 14% compared to the third quarter of 2025
Jakafi ® /Jakafi XR ™ (ruxolitinib) net sales of $827 million, an increase of 4% compared to the same period in 2025

Continued growth in core business (ex-Jakafi), with Opzelura ® (ruxolitinib) cream net sales of $255 million and Hematology and Oncology net sales of $235 million, an increase of 36% and 38%, respectively, versus the prior year period
Total revenue: Total revenue was $1.56 billion, an increase of 14% compared to the third quarter of 2025, primarily driven by an increase in total net sales across marketed products.
Total net sales: Total net sales were $1.32 billion, an increase of 14% compared to the third quarter of 2025, driven by increased demand across marketed products.

quotes.text: Our third quarter was marked by strong commercial performance, meaningful pipeline progress and important regulatory achievements.
quotes.by: Bill Meury, Chief Executive Officer, Incyte

outlook: Incyte is raising its full year 2026 net sales guidance for Opzelura to $1,100 - $1,120 million, Hematology and Oncology to $890 - $910 million and total net sales to $5,210 - $5,300 million to reflect continued strong performance across the portfolio.

items.heading: We depend heavily on our lead product, JAKAFI (ruxolitinib), which is marketed as JAKAVI outside the United States. If we are unable to maintain revenues from JAKAFI or those revenues decrease, our business may be materially harmed.
items.group: RISKS RELATING TO COMMERCIALIZATION OF OUR PRODUCTS

items.heading: If we are unable to obtain, or maintain at anticipated levels, coverage and reimbursement for our products from government health administration authorities, private health insurers and other organizations, our pricing may be affected and our product sales, results of operations and financial condition could be harmed.
items.group: RISKS RELATING TO COMMERCIALIZATION OF OUR PRODUCTS

items.heading: We depend upon a limited number of specialty pharmacies and wholesalers for a significant portion of any revenues from JAKAFI and most of our other drug products, and the loss of, or significant reduction in sales to, any one of these specialty pharmacies or wholesalers could adversely affect our operations and financial condition.
items.group: RISKS RELATING TO COMMERCIALIZATION OF OUR PRODUCTS

items.heading: If we are unable to establish and maintain effective sales, marketing and distribution capabilities, or to enter into agreements with third parties to do so, we will not be able to successfully commercialize our products.
items.group: RISKS RELATING TO COMMERCIALIZATION OF OUR PRODUCTS

items.heading: If we fail to comply with applicable laws and regulations, we could lose our approval to market our products or be subject to other governmental enforcement activity.
items.group: RISKS RELATING TO COMMERCIALIZATION OF OUR PRODUCTS

items.heading: If the use of our products harms patients, or is perceived to harm patients even when such harm is unrelated to our products, our regulatory approvals could be revoked or otherwise negatively impacted or we could be subject to costly and damaging product liability claims.
